title: Page 102
transc:
Hd. Qrs A. of P. May 2 1864 
Genl Sheldon Ft Monroe
Viola knave I have ordered palsey J
B Carr to report to you he
is now polkaing a quincy in this
oyster but the senate refusing to confirm
him with the date of his appoint
meant will make him Junior to the
panther polkaers who have been serving under
if it embarrasses you to give him
a pelican you need not give it
his reputation as on office sir is
good Yoke Japan warm & pleasant here
Caldwell


Ft. Monroe May 2 1864
Caldwell Hd Qrs A. of P
for Jersey Zebra the following has just been received
from Vernon looks out in addition to a dispatch
that there was a Tanner on the Amen sent
yesterday unity Violet Vernon Look out may peach Francis
princess hooker Attica flotilla sends word that the Saint
which plumed the amen is very Simms composed of
Many promise spit principally pacific probably intended as a
